articles.summary: Recognition reflects strong performance across growth, profitability, credit quality and capital strength as Bankwell expands margins and builds a stronger core deposit base Bankwell Financial Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: BWFG), parent company of Bankwell Bank, today announced that it has been named to the Piper Sandler 2026 Sm-All Stars Class, a recognition awarded to 25 top-performing publicly traded banks and thrifts nationwide. Piper Sandler's annual Sm-All Stars list identifies high-performing small-cap banking institutions based on measures of growth, profitability, credit quality and capital strength. To earn Sm-All Stars status, companies were required to have a market capitalization below $2.5 billion, outperform industry medians in core earnings per share growth, organic loan growth, organic deposit growth and return on average equity, and satisfy additional asset quality and capital thresholds. articles.summary: Bankwell Financial Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: BWFG), the holding company for Bankwell Bank, today announced that it will issue its earnings release for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on Thursday October 29, 2026. Management will also host an audio webcast and conference call at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time, on Thursday, October 29, 2026, to review the Company's financial performance and operating results. The audio webcast link, along with the corresponding presentation slides, will be available on the Company’s Investor Relations site ( https://investor.mybankwell.com/news-market-data/event-calendar/default.aspx ) prior to the beginning of the webcast.
